# exec outputs: `dir`, the `path` and `paths` outputs, rerunning or restoring
# a deleted output, and removing outputs on --clean.
bit
stdout '^ *show │ paths=\[sub/out\.txt, sub/gen/\] path=one\.txt$'
grep '\Ain\n\z' sub/out.txt
grep '/sub$' sub/pwd.txt
exists sub/gen

# A deleted output reruns a local-only target.
rm local.txt
bit --plan local
stdout '^local ~ .*''local\.txt'' \(removed\) changed\)$'
bit local
stdout '^local ▶ '
grep '\Arun\nrun\n\z' local.log
exists local.txt

# A cacheable target restores it from the shared cache instead.
rm sub/out.txt
bit build
stdout '^build ⇣ .*\(cached\)$'
stdout '^build │ restore sub/out\.txt$'
grep '\Ain\n\z' sub/out.txt
grep '\Arun\n\z' build.log

# --clean removes outputs, or runs `clean` instead when it is set.
bit --clean
stdout '^ *build ▶ rm sub/out\.txt$'
stdout '^ *custom │ cleaning$'
! exists sub/out.txt
! exists one.txt
! exists local.txt
exists custom.txt
exists cleaned.txt
exists sub/in.txt

bit --clean
stdout '^ *build · no state$'

-- BUILD.bit --
build = exec {
  dir = "sub"
  command = "echo run >> ../build.log; pwd > pwd.txt; cat in.txt > out.txt; test -d gen"
  inputs = ["in.txt"]
  outputs = ["out.txt", "gen/"]
}

one = exec {
  command = "echo one > one.txt"
  outputs = "one.txt"
}

show = exec {
  command = "echo paths=#{build.paths} path=#{one.path}"
}

local = exec {
  command = "echo run >> local.log; echo local > local.txt"
  outputs = "local.txt"
  resolve = "echo present"
}

custom = exec {
  command = "touch custom.txt"
  outputs = "custom.txt"
  clean = "echo cleaning; touch cleaned.txt"
}
-- sub/in.txt --
in
